Batch 10 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 10 resolves 18 historical serialized broadcasts from two of radio's most enduring narrative institutions: the 1942–1943 NBC Pacific Coast master recordings of Aunt Mary (sponsored by C&H Sugar, written by Gil Doud and Virginia Crosby) and the 1930 San Francisco transcription run of Cecil and Sally (starring Johnny Patrick and Helen Troy).

1. Aunt Mary — 1942–1943 NBC Pacific Coast Serial Dated

Set in the rural community of Wakefield and Malibu Beach, Aunt Mary followed Mary Lane's guidance through wartime family crises:
